Market today: Bond yields are the clear driver, spiking to 19-year highs and spooking stocks. This is hitting your concentrated tech/chip book hard.

Your holdings: SOXL (-35.24%) and SPAL (-33.46%) are the clear pain points needing attention. They are marked SELL and are leveraged ETFs, which amplify drops, especially on margin.

Watch: The 10-year Treasury yield is the main thing to watch. Its continued spike will pressure your tech holdings.

Bottom line: Focus on managing your leveraged losers and the overall market's reaction to rising yields.
plays: SOXL: Consider trimming or stopping out given the SELL status and significant loss, especially on margin.
SPAL: Similar to SOXL, evaluate trimming or stopping out due to the SELL status and leveraged nature.
No new buys today - hold and watch
